description: No API key needed; only `model` is required (e.g. {"model": "gpt-6.1-sol"}, defaults 2,000 tokens in and 400 out). Price a workload at list prices across models: cost per request and per month for the requested model, its cheaper sibling, and the effect of prompt caching. Pricing table version 2026-10-28.

model.description: model id, e.g. gpt-6.1-sol or claude-sonnet-5-5

static_tokens.description: portion of input_tokens that is a fixed prefix (system + tools)

name: calculate_model_arbitrage
title: Price a workload across models
